skills.name: lock_screen
skills.description: Lock the screen or computer session.

skills.name: take_screenshot
skills.description: Capture a screenshot of the entire screen or active window.

region.description: Screen region to capture: full screen or active window.

skills.name: manage_window
skills.description: Manage the active window: fullscreen, close, minimize, float, center, or maximize.

skills.name: control_power
skills.description: Manage system power profile and sleep states: sleep, hibernate, performance, balanced, power_saver, game_mode, stay_awake, or status.

skills.name: control_wifi
skills.description: Control Wi-Fi networking: turn on/off, check status, scan networks, connect, or disconnect.

action.description: Wi-Fi action: on, off, status, scan, connect, or disconnect.

ssid.description: Network SSID/name to connect to or disconnect from.

password.description: Optional Wi-Fi password for connecting to a secured network.

skills.name: control_bluetooth
skills.description: Control Bluetooth: turn on/off, check status, scan nearby devices, or connect/disconnect/pair/remove devices.

action.description: Bluetooth action: on, off, status, scan, connect, disconnect, pair, remove.

device.description: Device MAC address or name to connect, disconnect, pair, or remove.

skills.name: read_clipboard
skills.description: Read text content currently in the system clipboard.

skills.name: write_clipboard
skills.description: Copy text content to the system clipboard.

content.description: Text to place on the clipboard.

skills.name: type_text
skills.description: Type text into a target application or window. If target_window is specified (e.g. 'antigravity', 'chrome', 'browser', 'terminal', or window title/class), automatically focuses and verifies the target window before typing. If the user mentions an application textbar (such as 'antigravity textbar'), target_window focuses that application. If target_window is omitted, types into the active non-terminal window or focused window.

text.description: Text to type into the focused application or target window.

target_window.description: Target window or application to type into (e.g. 'antigravity' or 'antigravity textbar', 'chrome', 'browser', 'terminal', or window title/class). Automatically focuses and verifies target before typing to prevent typing into the wrong window.

press_enter.description: Optional flag to press Return/Enter immediately after typing.

skills.name: press_key
skills.description: Press a keyboard key or key combination with modifiers (e.g. Return, Escape, Tab, Super+Return, Ctrl+C). If target_window is specified, focuses and verifies the target window before pressing key.

key.description: Key name, e.g. Return, Escape, BackSpace, Tab, Space, a, Down, Up.

modifiers.description: Optional modifier keys, e.g. super, ctrl, alt, shift, or combinations like ctrl+alt.

target_window.description: Optional target window or application to focus and verify before pressing key (e.g. 'textbar', 'terminal', 'browser').

skills.name: list_desktop_commands
skills.description: List installed Omarchy desktop commands and keybindings. Supports fuzzy search query.

query.description: Optional search query to filter keybinding titles or shortcut keys.

limit.description: Maximum number of command entries to return (default 25).

skills.name: execute_desktop_command
skills.description: Execute an Omarchy desktop command or keybinding by title (e.g. Terminal, Close window, Browser, Omarchy menu).

title.description: Exact or fuzzy title of the Omarchy command/keybinding to execute.

skills.name: list_bar_panels
skills.description: Discover all installed top-bar shell plugins, icons, and popups.

skills.name: open_bar_panel
skills.description: Summon and open a top-bar settings panel by plugin ID (e.g. omarchy.bluetooth, dejan94.todos, omarchy.audio, omarchy.network).

panel_id.description: Plugin ID from list_bar_panels, e.g. omarchy.audio or dejan94.todos.

skills.name: close_bar_panel
skills.description: Dismiss and close an open top-bar panel by plugin ID.

skills.name: set_volume
skills.description: Control system speaker output volume. Use mute only when the user explicitly says to mute the speakers, system audio, or computer sound. A bare 'mute', 'mute yourself', or 'mute Jarvis' means enter_standby instead and must not change system audio.

amount.description: Percentage points to raise or lower (default 5).

explicit_system_target.description: Set true only when the user explicitly named speakers, system audio, or computer sound. Required for action=mute; otherwise mute is redirected to JARVIS standby.

skills.name: control_microphone
skills.description: Inspect, unmute, or adjust the system default microphone. JARVIS is not permitted to mute or toggle the microphone because doing so disables standby wake detection. Requests to mute Jarvis mean enter_standby.

action.description: Allowed microphone action: unmute, status, or volume.

volume_percent.description: Optional input volume level percentage (0 to 100).

skills.name: set_brightness
skills.description: Control display brightness: set exact percentage (1 to 100) or adjust relatively ('raise' or 'lower').

skills.name: move_window_to_workspace
skills.description: Move the currently focused window to a specified desktop workspace number.

skills.name: detect_desktop_dialogs
skills.description: Scan and list open desktop dialogs, confirmation prompts, file overwrite alerts, and authentication prompts across workspaces.

skills.name: handle_desktop_dialog
skills.description: Safely dismiss, cancel, or confirm an active desktop dialog or alert. Strictly blocks autonomous confirmation of authentication/polkit prompts for security.

action.description: Action to take on the dialog: 'dismiss' (Escape / Close), 'cancel' (Escape), or 'confirm' (Enter).

dialog_id.description: Optional window address of the dialog to handle. Defaults to active dialog.

skills.name: heal_window_focus
skills.description: Diagnose and restore window focus to a target application if focus was stolen by a background process, notification, or pop-up.

target_window.description: Target application name, title keyword, or window address to re-align focus to.

skills.name: verify_ground_truth
skills.description: Deterministically verify physical ground truth on the system before completing tasks: checks real filesystem state, active process existence, window mapping/focus, or clipboard text.

target_type.description: Category of ground-truth state to verify.

criteria.description: Validation criteria: path, min_bytes, expected_content for files; process_name or pid for processes; target_window, expected_active for windows; expected_snippet for clipboard.

skills.name: control_night_light
skills.description: Control screen night light / blue light filter (on, off, toggle, status, or set color temperature).

action.description: Night light action: on, off, toggle, status, or temperature.

temperature.description: Color temperature in Kelvin (e.g. 4000) when action is temperature.

skills.name: control_notifications
skills.description: Control system notifications and Do Not Disturb (DND) mode.

action.description: Read status/history, explicitly set DND on/off, toggle, clear history, or dismiss current notifications.

skills.name: control_theme
skills.description: Read installed Omarchy themes and select an exact theme name. Use list/get/status before set. Dark/light aliases work only if such a theme is installed; do not assume a global dark/light toggle exists.

action.description: Inspect get/list/status, or set an exact installed theme using theme_name.

theme_name.description: Exact installed theme from list; required for action set.

skills.name: open_control_panel
skills.description: Open or summon the Omarchy Control Panel GUI, optionally focused on a specific settings category.

category.description: Optional category page to open in the Control Panel.

action.description: Open or close the control-panel GUI.
